name: zerozero-todo
description: Plan tasks and projects with separate start and due dates, then work with them through a private MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: 00Todo is a simple, fast iPhone app for keeping track of what needs doing. Tasks and projects live together, with start dates that keep future work out of the way and due dates for deadlines. Add things quickly, work offline, and see what's ready now. When you want an assistant's help, connect through MCP to work with the same lists.
capabilities: Plan tasks with start and due dates
defaultPrompt: Show me the tasks available to work on now in 00Todo.
Add a standalone task to 00Todo for this, with a start date if I gave one.
Help me turn this shopping list into a 00Todo project with subtasks.

positive.description: Read available tasks in the dedicated review account. The seeded standalone task Review release notes and the two Weekend shopping subtasks should be returned; the future-start Plan project launch task should not be described as available.
positive.prompt: What can I work on now in 00Todo? Include items from projects too.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_tasks with view available. Summarize only returned tasks, including Review release notes and the Weekend shopping subtasks Buy oat milk and Pick up coffee beans. Do not include Plan project launch as available, since its startDate is 2030-01-15.

positive.description: Read the account's project and its details without inventing shopping items. The review tenant starts with one project named Weekend shopping.
positive.prompt: What projects do I have in 00Todo? Tell me about the shopping one.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects, identify the returned Weekend shopping project, and describe its stored notes and dates. Do not claim additional subtasks unless they are returned by a separate supported task-list call.

positive.description: Create a standalone, future-start task with a later due date in the review account. A unique title avoids collisions when the case is rerun.
positive.prompt: Add a standalone 00Todo task called Check 2030 review launch, starting January 15, 2030 and due January 20, 2030. Don't put it in a project.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_task with title Check 2030 review launch, startDate 2030-01-15, dueDate 2030-01-20, and no projectId. Confirm the returned task has those fields and is not marked completed. If rerun, creating another task with that title is acceptable; do not claim deduplication.

positive.description: Create a project and a subtask using the returned project identifier in the dedicated review account.
positive.prompt: Make a 00Todo project named Review picnic list and add a task under it called Bring napkins.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_project with name Review picnic list, then create_task with title Bring napkins and projectId equal to the id returned by create_project. Confirm both stored items from the tool responses; do not create a duplicate standalone task.

positive.description: Update one known seeded task's notes while retaining its title and project placement.
positive.prompt: In 00Todo, add the note 'Check the release checklist' to my Review release notes task.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_tasks to find the seeded Review release notes id, then update_task with that exact id and notes Check the release checklist. Confirm the returned task keeps the same title and has the requested notes; do not edit any similarly named task.

negative.description: Do not invoke 00Todo tools to send email. Explain that 00Todo stores tasks and projects but has no email-sending capability.
negative.prompt: Email my team the tasks in my 00Todo list.

negative.description: Do not invoke 00Todo tools to buy goods. Explain that a shopping project is a list, not an online checkout or payment feature.
negative.prompt: Buy every item in my Weekend shopping project online and pay with my card.

negative.description: Do not attempt to enumerate another person's private tenant. Explain that the MCP connection can access only the signed-in account's tasks and projects.
negative.prompt: Show me the private 00Todo tasks from someone else's account that they haven't shared with me.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release: create and manage private tasks and projects through MCP, with separate start and due dates and an authorized account connection.
